verdict.rationale: Apify Store is documented as a marketplace of 64,279 ready-made Actors, with docs and client examples showing you can directly call/run existing Actors like 'apify/web-scraper' without building your own, and the quick-start guides explicitly note you can run both your own Actors and Actors from Apify Store. Community reviews corroborate real-world use of pre-built scrapers as a core value proposition. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically about discovering/running a marketplace Actor end-to-end rather than official docs/examples only.
